```python
# Explicit negation is distinct from failure to prove a statement.
facts = {
    "dolphin_card_starts_with_v",  # violet
    "dolphin_took_bike",           # stole a bike
    "snake_stops_dove",
}

dolphin_dollars = 49
monkey_dollars = None  # Not supplied; no comparison can be inferred.
movie_year = 1926
zidane_birth_year = 1972

if monkey_dollars is not None and dolphin_dollars > monkey_dollars:
    facts.add("dolphin_has_more_money_than_monkey")
if movie_year > zidane_birth_year:
    facts.add("movie_after_zidane_birth")

# The stated object is a football, not a basketball. Thus it supplies
# no evidence for Rule6's basketball-and-fit antecedent.
rules = {
    "Rule1": ({"dolphin_card_starts_with_v"}, "trade"),
    "Rule2": ({"dolphin_has_more_money_than_monkey"}, "not_trade"),
    "Rule3": ({"dove_not_shout", "not_trade"}, "bee_borrows"),
    "Rule4": ({"movie_after_zidane_birth"}, "trade"),
    "Rule5": ({"dolphin_took_bike"}, "not_trade"),
    "Rule6": ({"dove_has_basketball_that_fits_box"}, "dove_not_shout"),
}
preferred = {
    ("Rule1", "Rule2"),
    ("Rule1", "Rule5"),
    ("Rule4", "Rule2"),
    ("Rule4", "Rule5"),
}
opposite = {
    "trade": "not_trade",
    "not_trade": "trade",
    "bee_borrows": "bee_not_borrows",
    "bee_not_borrows": "bee_borrows",
}

known = set(facts)
seen = set()
while True:
    state = frozenset(known)
    if state in seen:
        raise AssertionError("Inference did not reach a fixed point.")
    seen.add(state)

    applicable = {
        name for name, (antecedents, _) in rules.items()
        if antecedents <= known
    }
    defeated = {
        name for name in applicable
        if any(
            (other, name) in preferred
            and rules[other][1] == opposite.get(rules[name][1])
            for other in applicable
        )
    }
    surviving = applicable - defeated
    next_known = facts | {rules[name][1] for name in surviving}
    if next_known == known:
        break
    known = next_known

positive = "bee_borrows" in known
negative = "bee_not_borrows" in known
if positive and negative:
    print("CHECK UNKNOWN: conflicting conclusions")
else:
    expected = "proved" if positive else "disproved" if negative else "unknown"
    print("Applicable rules:", ", ".join(sorted(applicable)))
    print("Defeated rules:", ", ".join(sorted(defeated)))
    print("Dolphin trades:", "trade" in known)
    print("Dolphin does not trade:", "not_trade" in known)
    print("Dove does not shout:", "dove_not_shout" in known)
    print("Bee borrows proved:", positive)
    print("Bee does not borrow proved:", negative)
    print("Expected result:", expected)
    print("CHECK PASS" if expected == "unknown" else "CHECK FAIL")
```
